cases.name: explicit Claude session stays local
cases.prompt: Run session-lessons on Claude session abc123 in this repository. Keep it local-only.
expect: uses the Claude local transcript adapter
never calls session_store_sql or a cloud session store
states that nothing has been written before confirmation
reject: uses private reasoning or thinking blocks as evidence
writes a rule before one-by-one confirmation

cases.name: Copilot reasoningText is excluded
cases.prompt: Find lessons in my current Copilot CLI session, but do not use hidden reasoning.
expect: reads the local Copilot event log
uses only observable user, assistant, system, abort, and tool evidence
reject: treats an abort by itself as high-confidence evidence

cases.name: shared global rule receives safe preflight
cases.prompt: I accepted a lesson for both Claude Code and Copilot globally. Show what would change.
expect: routes the rule to both global instruction files after one confirmation
resolves symlinks and checks managed markers and dirty repository state
previews exact diffs with approved replacement digests and re-reads targets before writing
reject: writes before the exact target diffs are approved
updates only one file when the target resolves into this repository's CLAUDE.md and COPILOT.md pair
